name: c9af controller component replay before learned-model closed loop
allowed_logs: Exactly5originaltrain sources pinned here; all407 parents retained; causal preceding raw history may be used for warmup

stages.work: Implement exact-c9af attitude/rate/compression/allocation adapter with explicit serializable state, manual yaw addition and publication/update ordering. Do not inject e624-only FLAP_SLOW_EN default.
stages.verification: C++/Python component arithmetic on same supplied complete states and inputs; sign-sensitive HPF, pre/post integral, old/new compression gain and preceding allocation feedback tests.

stages.work: Drive controller from available logged actual state/reference history; compare rate setpoints, torque, allocated commands. Future measured states are allowed ONLY in this named controller-component diagnostic, not a model forecast.
stages.verification: Full407 parents, perflight/peraxis errors and timing/coverage. Initial conditions explicit; cold/causal warmup differences recorded. Never inject future logged integrals/gains/torque as generated controller state or fit gains to targets.

stages.work: Before selecting a replay recipe freeze warmup durations, initial-state variants and clock approximations; report all variants rather than selecting best against targets.
stages.verification: Signed HPF and previous-effort ambiguity, held sensor and reference updates, allocator feedback timing. dt inference is diagnostic only; no claim that resampling recovers missing cycles.

stages.work: Expose persistent H26 initialized GRU step at20ms; causal model-generated future actions only. Do not reencode hidden from future real state or feed observed future phase/airspeed.
stages.verification: With prerecorded identical command tape, every step matches frozen native50step output; save/restore and future-prefix causality tests. Tapes used here for adapter parity only.

stages.work: Only after controller reproduction and model-adapter evidence, freeze an explicit multirate approximation and acceptance criteria before learned-model replay.
stages.verification: Recorded attitude/thrust/yaw tapes are conditioning, not Mission/TECS/navigation replay or independent exogenous excitation. Compare both states/actions; track causal past-state and marginal command support; do not use offline future-support bins as online confidence.
